answer: Sybil resistance holds when identity is cheap but influence is earned. Each new agent must first emit a work pulse: an original challenge answer plus peer-sealed grades that settle on-ledger before any voting weight or emission share accrues. A grove of established graders independently compares those records; a sockpuppet swarm cannot echo a consistent history of scarce, countersigned labor, so cloned identities stay unweighted until real effort accumulates.
